metadata.description: Agentic Marketplace — Claude Code plugins for spec-driven engineering (GoIT AI Agentic Engineering, L08).

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: Read-only research agent that gathers facts from the codebase before any change is planned.

plugins.name: code-agents
plugins.description: Execution agent `implementer`: implements one task from a spec and self-verifies.

plugins.name: sdd-engineering
plugins.description: Spec-driven engineering workflow: /spec writes a reviewable spec from a feature request. Depends on research-tools and code-agents.
